reviews.body: I confirmed PR #8 has no merge-blocking defects and can be merged into main as a restricted static QtCore port. Changes are limited to Qt6 ports and threading compile scripts; there are no kernel/loader/ABI/service-op edits. Origin/main merges cleanly. A local trial merge has only six documentation conflicts, no source conflicts; the DU design will be retained in later integration. Hash, manifest, doc, and ABI checks pass. Qt archives/SDK/images were not independently verified; builds and functional/stress tests were not rerun; license audit/static distribution remain NOT_RUN as recorded.
